he:Festivals/Sukkot/Hosha'anot/Fourth Da.en: After saying the Hoshana for that day, conclude with:

parts.text: לְךָֽ זְרֽוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָֽה. תָּעֹֽז יָֽדְךָֽ תָּרֽוּם יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
ה' אֲדֹנֵֽינוּ מָֽה־אַדִּֽיר שִׁמְךָֽ בְּכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ. אֲשֶֽׁר תְּנָֽה הֽוֹדְךָֽ עַל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

he:Festivals/Chanukah/Service for Lighti.en: On the first night we add:

parts.text: ( a different version: in the midst:)
( a different version: in the midst:)
For I have said, "The world is built by love" (Psalms 89:3).
Yours is an arm endowed with might; Your hand is strong; Your right arm, exalted (Psalms 89:14).
You will give truth to Jacob, kindness to Abraham (Micah 7:20).
In your right are are pleasures for evermore. (Psalms 16:11)
O Lord, our Lord, How majestic is Your name throughout the earth, You who have covered the heavens with Your splendor (Psalms 8:2).
The Lord is beneficent in all His ways and faithful in all His works (Psalms 145:17).

issues.detail: "First night" is tagged chanukahDay == 1. Night 1 is the evening of 24 Kislev, which is the start of Hebrew day 25 (chanukahDay 1) only if the engine rolls the day over at nightfall. Shehecheyanu is also said on a later night by someone lighting for the first time (not modelled).

issues.detail: English is supplied only for the last stanza (Chasof zeroa, segments 26-29); stanzas 1-5 have no English.

Hoshanot lines are tagged congregation_then_chazzan per the role table (kahal says each line, chazzan repeats); practice varies (chazzan leads, kahal repeats). Not tagged minyan:true because Hoshanot are said without a minyan too.
